title: MZ SV_Battler sprite mostly using Idle Sprite

posts.author: Gatamandra
posts.body:
Hi! this might be super silly, using this image from this super useful  thread:
https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/index.php?threads/rpg-maker-mv-mz-templates-and-guideline.46839/
I was trying to give  bit more live to the sprites in battle in my game, animating more the spridesheet for sv_battlers, however I noticed that even copypaste-ing the "Idle" animation into the "Ready/Phisical" "Ready Magical" "Guard" "Crisis/Danger" and "Abnormal State" (as I don´t want it to be as complex, so I just want the idle animation keep playing in those moments) the engine still refreshes them in battle making the animation go uncordinated, and is a bit distracting, so I was wondering if it´d be possible to have a plugin that makes so that for those action it doesn´t refresh the sprite to keep the idle animation playing.
I´m using YEP Battle core and YEP SVEnemieSprite plugins but I couldn´t find anything there to fix it, I also tried deep diving in the js.files but I wasn´t even sure were to even look for it.
EDIT: re-reading my post I don´t know if it´s a bit confusing, I would like the battler's animations to be mainly on their idle animation and be as much on synch as possible. so I thought by doing what is written up could be a start, but later I thought maybe the main goal wasn´t very well explained, thanks a mil!!
Thanks a mil!!

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:
You could just open your rpg_sprites.js in the js folder of your project, scroll to line 649 and change the motion directly. (Or for good practice, copy the function and put it in a new file, call it ActorMotions.js or whatever and use as a plugin. It's better to not edit core scripts directly.)
Not sure if it will still do a hiccup, but worth a shot.
as for using a skill, you could use yanfly's action sequence packs and just leave the <target action> / <whole action> empty. Then the sprite will just continues to idle.
